description: Brand how a project's room links unfurl in chats/social (Discord, Slack, iMessage, X) and fill its public game page. Owner-scoped — needs login. Set any of: name (the link title), description (the blurb; pass "" to clear), about + rules (the game page's crawlable content — write these for every game you deploy), and an image via imageUrl (https) OR imageData (base64 or data: URI — uploaded & hosted) OR clearImage:true to revert to the default. Only one image action per call.

about.description: What the game is and what makes it fun — shown on its /p page + in-room info panel, ≤ 1200 chars. Pass "" to clear.

clearImage.description: Revert the image to the site's default share card.

description.description: Unfurl description, ≤ 200 chars. Pass "" to clear it.

imageData.description: Image as base64 or a data: URI (PNG/JPEG/WebP, ≤ 2 MB) — uploaded and hosted.

imageUrl.description: External https:// image URL (stored as-is; recommended 1200×630).

name.description: Unfurl title / game rename. Non-empty, ≤ 80 chars.

projectId.description: The project whose share preview to set.

rules.description: How to play — controls, goal, rules. Shown under "How to play", ≤ 2000 chars. Pass "" to clear.

name: set_share_preview
